description: 13-min two-person standup. A single Alice turn (590s–610s) spans the 600s chunk seam — the exact case the whole-file engine must keep as ONE speaker and the old per-chunk path splits.

reference.text: Morning. Yesterday I finished the auth migration and started on the rate limiter.
Nice. I was blocked on the staging DB but it's back up now, so I'll pick up the export job today.
Great. Any concerns on the timeline for the export job?
Should be fine. Two days at most. I'll ping you if the schema surprises me.
Quick follow-up from earlier: the rate limiter needs a config flag before we ship.
Add it to the feature flags doc and I'll wire it up.
One more thing before we wrap, this is the important bit that runs across the chunk boundary so keep me as one speaker here.
Got it, sounds good, I'll take the action item.
